title: The Dog Who Waited 10 Years at Platform 4 🐕💔 #Shorts
description:
Every morning at 7:45, Barnaby walked his owner to Platform 4. Every evening at 5:15, he waited for his return. One rainy evening... the train returned empty. His owner had passed away. But Barnaby didn't understand death. For 10 long years in freezing snow, he never left that bench... until the golden train arrived. 🐕😭

Watch the full 3-minute emotional short film on our channel: What If Studio
